events.name: Bash
events.head: Show task tool usage and find Zoom settings code
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -30; grep -rIl "zoom_s2s_enc\|zoom_support_locks" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls ~/.config/tantra/ 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the existing Zoom support check script
events.input: $ wc -l workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs; cat workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | head -150; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs; git status --short workshop-plan/ops | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the daily job and run the read-only Zoom check
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.zoom-support-check.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ | grep -i -E "zoom|No such"; launchctl list | grep -i zoom; git log --oneline -5 --grep="T-225"; node workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60
